title: Minesweeper
body:
## Adds Minesweeper to Minecraft!
You can press [M] to open the game while in a world.
Right click a tile to add a flag
Left click a tile to uncover it
Win by flagging all the mines and uncovering the rest of the board!

Game stats get tracked internally for now. Displaying them in-game will come in a future release.

## Special functionality:
When on the PvPLegacy server, the game closes and pauses when exiting spectator mode.
